card.name: The word with after reconstitute vial
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after a vial or drug name in reconstitution or dilution directions, just before the volume and diluent. It also fires weakly on similar instruction words such as "with water".

modes.label: Reconstitute with diluent
modes.description: "with" after a vial, powder or drug name in a reconstitution step, before an amount of fluid.
modes.example: Reconstitute each 300 mg vial<< with>> 19.5 mL of

modes.label: Dilute with fluid
modes.description: "with" after a diluted product, introducing the infusion fluid.
modes.example: TREANDA for Injection (25 mg/vial or 100 mg/vial lyophilized powder) Once diluted<< with>> either 0.9% Sodium Chlor
